clue.text: Railway enthusiast coaches a worker in ceramics

parts.note: railway coaches make up trains
a potter makes pots and other ceramics

explanation.surface: A railway buff is apparently giving lessons to someone who makes pottery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coaches' looks like a verb (trains people) but is the noun: carriages, which together make TRAINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who logs locomotive numbers as a hobby is the classic railway hobbyist.

clue.text: Paddy has so much French spirit

parts.note: tant is French for so much
rum is a spirit distilled from sugar cane

explanation.surface: Someone, perhaps Irish, owns a great deal of French liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paddy' looks like a name, but in British English a paddy is a fit of temper.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a paddy is a fit of rage, an outburst of bad temper.

clue.text: Very little seafood is put in a herbal garnish

indicators.note: the answer is placed inside the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A tiny portion of seafood is served inside a garnish of herbs.
explanation.walkthrough: A single alga is a microscopic piece of seaweed, the 'seafood' here: it sits across herbAL GArnish.
explanation.definitionFit: One seaweed organism is minute, so a single water plant counts as a tiny bit of marine growth.

clue.text: Unjust way to describe a brunette

definitions.meaning: a brunette has dark hair, the opposite of fair-haired

explanation.surface: Calling a dark-haired woman something is an unkind description.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses deny fairness: one of justice, the other of blonde colouring.

clue.text: What the armed thug may take when cannabis is stolen

definitions.text: What the armed thug may take

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
is contracted to 's
hot is slang for stolen goods

explanation.surface: A gunman might fire off a round during a drugs theft.
explanation.definitionFit: A random, opportunistic shot is what a gunman might loose off.

clue.text: Go for a spin

definitions.meaning: a go is one's chance in a game, as in 'your go'

explanation.surface: Head out for a drive in the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Your move in a game and a rotation are both expressed by the same short word.

clue.text: I would enter a sporting contest-that's obvious

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so the I'd goes into the contest word

parts.note: an event is a contest at a sports meeting
taken as written
I would contracts to I'd, giving D

explanation.surface: Plainly I would sign up for a sports competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obvious is plain or clearly apparent.

clue.text: The food of rasher Elizabethan and Georgian statesmen?

parts.note: Francis Bacon was a statesman under Elizabeth I
the Earl of Sandwich was an eighteenth-century statesman under George III

explanation.surface: A question about what bolder politicians of two historical eras ate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rasher' reads as 'more rash', but it is the slice of bacon. The statesmen are Francis Bacon and the 4th Earl of Sandwich, who gave the snack its name.
explanation.definitionFit: A rasher of bacon between bread is a classic British snack.

clue.text: Rough water here by the harbour'"?

definitions.text: Rough water here by the harbour

indicators.note: by means next to, so the harbour word follows
rough water is churned up, so these letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: a port is a harbour

explanation.surface: Choppy seas near the harbour are a matter for the forecast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rough' signals the anagram and 'by' places the harbour word after it; the whole clue also describes what the forecast covers.
explanation.definitionFit: A forecast describing rough seas at the coast is a broadcast about meteorological conditions.

clue.text: The time to take that gin cocktail?

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A suggestion of when to drink a mixed gin drink.
explanation.definitionFit: After dark is a time of day, an evening hour for a drink.

clue.text: Expression I note is of interest to the entomologist

parts.note: a term is a word or expression
taken as written
te is the seventh note in tonic sol-fa

explanation.surface: A phrase and a musical note concern an insect specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Entomologists study insects, and the wood-eating ant-like creature is one.

clue.text: A dour Scot is hiding yours and mine

indicators.note: hiding means concealing the answer within the following words

explanation.surface: A grim Scotsman is concealing property that belongs to both of us.
explanation.definitionFit: What belongs to you and me together is what belongs to us.

clue.text: Where to conceal cash, so they say

indicators.note: so they say signals that the word is as heard spoken

parts.note: cash is money

explanation.surface: Advice on a hiding place for money.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidden store or stash is a place to hide things.

clue.text: A very large number consume it

definitions.text: A very large number consume it

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
consume means eat

explanation.surface: Lots of people eat this food.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: flesh food is what multitudes eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal flesh is a staple food eaten by vast numbers of people.

clue.text: Tree most appropriate for the kirk

definitions.text: Tree most appropriate for the kirk

parts.words: Tree most appropriate for the kirk
parts.note: a kind of tree that shares its name with a lay officer of a Presbyterian church

explanation.surface: Which tree best suits a Scottish church?
explanation.walkthrough: The kirk is the Church of Scotland, whose congregations are governed by lay officials of this title.
explanation.definitionFit: The tree name doubles as the title of a governing official in a Presbyterian congregation.

clue.text: He tempts many to sin

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
evil is sin or wickedness

explanation.surface: A seducer leads a great number into wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan is the tempter of mankind in Christian tradition.

clue.text: One who tries to make a piece of embroidery

definitions.meaning: someone who tastes or tests things
a stitched cloth showing various stitches, often with an alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone attempting to stitch decorative needlework.
explanation.definitionFit: A taster tests samples; a needlework panel demonstrates a range of stitches.

clue.text: Operations room is where the drama is

definitions.meaning: an operating ... is a room for surgery
plays are staged at a playhouse

explanation.surface: A surgical suite is where the excitement happens.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a surgical room and a playhouse.

clue.text: Did President Roosevelt's policy call for a reshuffle?

definitions.meaning: a card player asking for the cards to be dealt again

explanation.surface: Did Roosevelt's programme demand a change of cabinet?
explanation.definitionFit: Roosevelt's Depression programme had this name; a card player wanting fresh hands asks for one.

clue.text: Charming encouragement not to lose them all

definitions.text: encouragement not to lose them all
definitions.meaning: from the saying 'you ..., you lose some'

explanation.surface: A delightful pep talk urging that not everything be lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Winning and appealing mean the same; the saying consoles a loser.

clue.text: The young bounder always gets let outside

indicators.note: outside means the word let goes around the other piece

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A youthful cad is always allowed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bounder' looks like an old word for a cad, but here it is something that bounds: a hare.
explanation.definitionFit: A young hare, a creature that leaps, is called by this name.

clue.text: He may get a bird's-eye view of a Roman road and hill

definitions.text: He may get a bird's-eye view

parts.note: via is Latin for road
a tor is a rocky hill

explanation.surface: Someone might look down from above on an ancient road and hill.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot looks down on the land as birds do.

clue.text: Contract to construct a flyover

definitions.meaning: a flyover is one bridge, so building it is making a bridge

explanation.surface: An agreement to build an elevated road.
explanation.definitionFit: To shorten a text, and the phrase naming one span carrying a road.

clue.text: Male accessories fabricate in spite

indicators.note: to fabricate is to make up, so the letters are made into a new word

explanation.surface: Men's items are made out of malice.
explanation.definitionFit: Pins securing neckwear are traditionally gentlemen's accessories.

clue.text: Lack desire

explanation.surface: Not having something makes you long for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a shortage and a wish are named by the same short word.

clue.text: Trevor has no right doing a somersault in public

indicators.note: a somersault turns head over heels, so the letters are reversed
has no right means the letter R, for right, is dropped

explanation.surface: Trevor tumbles in front of everyone, without justification.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping one R from TREVOR leaves TREVO, which reads backwards as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done openly is done publicly, not hidden.

clue.text: Distress call from a man with a record

parts.note: he refers to a man
LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A man with a vinyl album sends out a plea for rescue.
explanation.definitionFit: A cry for aid is the word shouted by someone in distress.

clue.text: Abel is utterly competent

indicators.note: utterly is read as altered utterly, so the letters of the name are reordered

explanation.surface: The biblical Abel is thoroughly capable.
explanation.definitionFit: Capable and competent are synonyms.

clue.text: It lies out at sea

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the word are put out of order

explanation.surface: Something is located offshore in the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: an island lies out at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A small island sits surrounded by ocean.

clue.text: Barristers boast initially that it gives a lot of leverage

definitions.text: it gives a lot of leverage

indicators.note: initially means the boasting word is placed first

parts.note: to crow is to boast
the bar is the collective name for barristers

explanation.surface: Lawyers brag at first that it provides considerable influence.
explanation.definitionFit: An iron bar used to prise things open is a lever.

clue.text: Brief recollection of Sid Rose

indicators.note: read as re-collection, the letters are gathered again in a new order

explanation.surface: A summary of what someone remembers of a person called Sid Rose.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief is a file of case papers, a collection of documents on a matter.

clue.text: Despite that, is it for evermore?

definitions.meaning: despite that means however or all the same
read as '...', asking whether it will never be less, so always the same

explanation.surface: Even so, does this last forever?
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means however, and split into three words says it will never diminish.
